_note: Libro operator fleet-dispatch template. Replace all {{PLACEHOLDER}} values at install time via install.sh. Three-tier resolver: normalize alias → tier → host, with catalog fallback.

resolution._note: Three-tier resolver: (1) normalize route alias to canonical tier, (2) resolve tier to host, (3) catalog fallback when LiteLLM down.

policy._note: Replace us_only with operator policy. Default: US-origin models only; adjust excluded_origins per your own origin policy.

traffic_routing._note: hub_litellm = operator's LiteLLM proxy. local_ollama = on-prem Ollama fleet.

hub.notes: LiteLLM proxy host. Set LITELLM_URL and LITELLM_MASTER_KEY in operator env.

local_primary.notes: Primary local inference node. Tailscale or LAN URL.

local_fallback.notes: Fallback local inference node. Resumes primary on primary node failure.

C-local._note: Fast/cheap tier. Default: llama3.1:8b or phi4:14b.

A-local._note: Heavy local tier. Default: gemma4:31b or llama3.3:70b.

A-cloud._note: Cloud frontier tier. Default: claude-sonnet-4-6 or gpt-4o.

env_override._note: install.sh writes these from operator profile at install time.

candidate_models._note: Operator-customizable model roster. Add/remove per BYOM pattern.

cost_caps._note: Set in operator profile. LiteLLM budget_manager enforces these.
